title: Never Can Say Goodbye
notes: Pioneering continuous disco side meets compact R&B songs; Gaynor balances urgency and romantic melancholy.

title: Experience Gloria Gaynor
notes: Long dance-floor suite contrasts with slower Northern soul interpretations and expressive ballad singing.

title: I've Got You
notes: Disco medley recasts a Porter standard; slower, string-backed soul occupies the contrasting second side.

title: Glorious
notes: Orchestrated disco-soul with stronger guitar presence, changing tempos and ballads between dance-floor tracks.

title: Gloria Gaynor's Park Avenue Sound
notes: Philadelphia session players bring lush, buoyant disco-soul and romantic midtempo passages.

title: Love Tracks
notes: I Will Survive anchors vigorous orchestral disco alongside intimate soul and Motown-influenced songs.

title: I Have a Right
scene: Los Angeles orchestrated disco and Northern soul
notes: Long theatrical disco performances alternate with slower soul; Tonight adds dramatic orchestration and trumpet.

title: Stories
notes: Compact dance tracks and Northern soul slow jams share warm arrangements and narrative lyrics.
